layout.body:
To: Mr. Fleming,
From: Bradley Art Museum
Date: April 19
Dear Mr. Fleming,
I would like to sincerely thank you for your very generous art donation to the Bradley Art Museum, As a small gesture of thanks, the Museum board would like to offer you a V.l.P. pass for you and any guests you choose to accompany you to our new and exciting exhibition in Scotland starting on May 28. This exhibition has been in the making now for 10 years and we are sure that you and yours will truly enjoy the event.
This V. l. P. pass also includes complimentary meals at our newly refurbished restaurant in addition to a champagne reception when you first arrive. We also have at your disposal a museum store where you can purchase many special gifts for your family and friends back home. Products consist of high quality books, eyewear, and perfumes.
On May 29, we are going to start the special series on several kinds of topics. In particular, on the evening of May 30, there will be a talk given by Ralf Simmons concerning “The Art Behind the Art.” This will take place in Carney Hall and next day, visitors will be offered a guided tour of the museum grounds. Details of the show itself will be sent to you in our April 25 newsletter in which you'll find plenty of information to get you started.
Kindest Regards,
Jane Chapel
Museum Director

questions.stem: Why was a V.l.P. pass sent to Mr. Fleming?

options.A: To provide donations to a charity drive
options.B: To finance him for his art study
options.C: To appreciate his contribution to the exhibition
options.D: To thank him for patronizing the museum for a long time

questions.analysis: Why was a V.I.P. pass sent to Mr. Fleming? 原文依据：I would like to sincerely thank you for your very generous art donation to the Bradley Art Museum. As a small gesture of thanks… offer you a V.I.P. pass. 发送 VIP 通行证是为了感谢并肯定他对博物馆的捐赠与贡献。 A：为慈善活动提供捐款 → 关系相反 B：资助他的艺术学习 → 未提及 C：感谢他对展览 / 博物馆的贡献 → 正确 D：感谢长期光顾 → 未提及

questions.stem: What facility is NOT stated as part of the Bradley Art Museum?
questions.analysis: What facility is NOT stated as part of the Bradley Art Museum? 原文依据： newly refurbished restaurant（A 正确） museum store（C 正确） Carney Hall（可举办讲座，D 正确） 文中没有提到 amusement park（游乐园）。 A：重新装修的餐厅 → 提到 B：游乐园 → 未提到，正确答案 C：纪念品商店 → 提到 D：演讲厅 → 提到

questions.stem: When will museum staff show visitors around the exhibits in person?
questions.analysis: When will museum staff show visitors around the exhibits in person? 原文依据：on the evening of May 30… next day, visitors will be offered a guided tour of the museum grounds. May 30 的第二天 = May 31。
